scope: Independent read-only product/lifecycle source review and actual original PNG inspection; no Android acceptance, rerun or source mutation.

actual_visual_inspection.claim: This captured frame is native Village content, not a visible Flutter return. A temporary compositor/rotation snapshot or a persistent visual resumption failure cannot be distinguished from this one post-return capture.

attempts.scope: Rendered content readiness, not an accessibility or gameplay check

source_findings: Native settlement _leave targets games for embedded livingVillage; SceneRouter.goto intercepts embedded games and calls HostBridge.return_to_app instead of loading a native game hub.

HostBridge accepts durable Android acknowledgement, then emits its games return marker. Android records the return, queues RESULT_OK and finish on the UI thread, and kills only the native process after 500ms. This acknowledgement is not a Flutter paint-completion signal.

MainActivity waits for native process shutdown before completing the launch callback. Flutter launchLumo3D closes its entry overlay in finally. GamesContent synchronizes pending events; EmbeddedGameService maps games to LumoSection.games and AppShell navigation.

Generated LumoGameActivity requests sensorLandscape; MainActivity inherits FlutterActivity without an app-defined onResume/render/orientation override. This is consistent with a landscape-to-portrait return transition, but does not prove a later successful rendered Flutter frame.

capture_when_ready accepts the first PNG with central-content entropy >=3.0. It explicitly requires independent page identity checking. The original journal accepted one native frame, entropy4.971, elapsed1.617seconds.

visible_return performs its exact Spielen OCR/replay check once on that accepted PNG, before recording returned accessibility XML. The required original visible Flutter evidence was absent; no pass is warranted.

qa_timeline_context.attribution: Reported by android_qa from its exclusively downloaded original all-buffer log; not independently reparsed in this review.
qa_timeline_context.interpretation_limit: Capture completion timestamp does not prove which intermediate display buffer was sampled. There is no later Flutter PNG in the failed probe.

requirements_for_any_probe_repair: No production bytes change without a concrete product defect.
Exactly one original visible Spiele return touch, using the existing two stable native-frame observations.
Same original host PID, absent native PID and resumed MainActivity remain required.
Observe fresh uniquely named PNGs and current original OCR/TSV; preserve their source hashes. Never reinterpret native Spiele as Flutter Spielen.
Retain strict original caption replay and enabled Flutter accessibility/portal validation; entropy alone is never page identity.
Retain the existing bounded waiting deadline and check it after every potentially blocking observation and before acceptance; a late match fails.
No additional tap, rotation, relaunch, injected app state, name tolerance or increased timeout.
Keep original preference preservation, ACK and fatal-log checks.
A new observer revision on the unchanged 6b APK is a separately bound diagnosis; it cannot retroactively turn this failed original run into a pass.
conclusion: A missing bounded observation of genuinely rendered Flutter content is concretely established. No incorrect product return destination was found. A persistent rendering defect is not ruled out; a fresh real device diagnosis must decide.
